scenario.brief: Sam is on call. Release 1.5.0 of bookstore-api will not finish deploying, and its tasks keep stopping. Sam has pasted notes and can run about six more lookups. Find the cause and what to do first.
scenario.role: Engineer helping the on-call teammate during an incident.
scenario.goal: Find why the new tasks fail, say what to do first, and say how to fix it for good.
rules: Sam can read from the notes and run about six more lookups.
Ask for evidence, not opinions. Sam reports only what a lookup shows.
Say your hypothesis before you ask, then test it.
When you have a diagnosis and a plan, press End and debrief.
scenario.artifactNote: A snapshot at 10:48 UTC. Events, logs and metrics as Sam pasted them. Read it before you ask.

levels: Not raised
Notes that tasks are stopped for failing load balancer health checks
Also reads the target-health reason and notices that no `GET /health` ever reaches the new tasks
Not raised
Asks whether users are affected
Sees that the old tasks still serve all traffic: a stuck deployment, not an outage

rubric.criterion: Rules out network, startup and resources
levels: Not raised
Checks one area, such as ports or memory
Rules out ports, security group, slow start and resources with evidence

rubric.criterion: Asks focused questions within the budget
levels: Vague or repeated questions; lookups wasted
Some lookups test a clear hypothesis
Every lookup tests a stated hypothesis and narrows the search
Not found
Suspects the app is unreachable from outside the task
Finds that release 1.5.0 binds to 127.0.0.1 and no `HOST` is set
Agrees to raise the grace period, or never addresses it
Doubts it but cannot say why
Explains that a longer grace period only delays the stop and refused connections never recover
Not raised
Mentions rolling back
Rolls back to `bookstore-api:11` first and explains that it ends the churn safely

rubric.criterion: Fixes the cause and proves it
levels: Not raised
Proposes binding to all interfaces or setting `HOST`
Also verifies healthy targets and `/health` log lines, and adds a circuit breaker
